meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides app prompts, cookie banner and screen time sheets; blurs or hides thumbnails, avatars and hashtags; hides music and follows
meta.notes:
LIVE (logged out, headless Chromium, iPhone UA 390x844 for the mobile web app and a macOS Safari UA 1440x900 for the desktop site, 2026-11-13; www.tiktok.com served the mobile app and the desktop app without a bot wall). Counts are querySelectorAll on the live DOM.

Mobile feed (/foryou): author avatars 2 ([data-e2e="video-author-avatar"]), sound name 2 ([data-e2e="music-name"]), music disc 2 ([data-e2e="music-cover"]), follow + badges 2 ([class*="DivFollowPlus"]), caption hashtag links 5-9 ([class*="DivVideoCaption"] a[href^="/tag/"]), caption text spans 7 ([class*="DivVideoCaption"] [class*="DivOverflowContainer"] > span), the caption "more" button 2 ([class*="DivVideoCaption"] [class*="DivBtnWrapper"]), like/comment/share counts 2 each, screen time sheets 3 (.box-border:has(.tt-intro__container), titles "Screen time breaks", "To support your well-being, your daily screen time", "Ready to close TikTok?"). The sheet and its dim backdrop sit inside the same .box-border, so one rule removes both.

Mobile /@tiktok: profile picture 1 ([data-e2e="user-avatar"]), grid covers 24 ([data-e2e="video-item"] img), Playlist and Liked tabs 1 each, Follow button 1, bio 1, link 1. Mobile /discover: grid covers 12. Mobile video page: author picture 2 ([data-e2e="play-side-author"] img), recommendation covers 60.

Desktop /foryou: Get App button 1 ([data-e2e="side-nav-utilities-get-app"]), favorite count 1, Follow button next to the creator 1 ([data-e2e="cinema-video-info-follow"]), creator picture 1, caption hashtag links 3-5 ([data-e2e="video-desc"] a[href^="/tag/"]). Desktop video page: music disc 2 ([data-e2e="video-music"]). Desktop /@tiktok: Suggested accounts panel 1 ([class*="DivUserCardListContainer"]), profile grid covers 32 when the grid renders ([data-e2e="user-post-item"] img; later loads showed the empty-profile state), Videos/Short dramas/Reposts/Favorites/Liked tabs 1 each, profile picture 1. Desktop /discover: popular creators row 1 ([class*="DivDiscoverUserCardSwiperContainer"]).

SOURCE: JustZix "TikTok: hide suggested accounts" and "TikTok: hide all engagement counts" (the same blocks and counts), the tiktok-unhook extension (hides vanity metrics) and AdGuardFilters issue 235370 (TikTok nag pop-ups).

Not verified: logged-in pages (comments, notifications, inbox, live studio, coins), the EU cookie banner, ads and sponsored items, TikTok Shop, the /live catalogue, and whether the screen time sheets are shown to every account (they were in the DOM but parked off-screen). The mobile fixtures are hand-written from the live DOM; the desktop ones are captured structures with text and personal data removed.
